summary: Solstice Advanced Materials Inc. filed an 8-K on July 6, 2026, announcing a definitive merger agreement to acquire Element Solutions Inc. via two-step mergers using subsidiaries. Element Solutions shareholders will receive Solstice common stock as consideration (exchange ratio not stated). Boards unanimously approved; no deal value, premium, or advisory fees disclosed. The transaction is structured as a tax-free reorganization under Section 368(a). Regulatory and shareholder approvals are required. Watch for stock-for-stock arb spread and closing timeline.
